response.sql:
WITH pattern_averages AS (
    SELECT `ANA Pattern` AS pattern, AVG(`aCL IgG`) AS avg_acl_igg
    FROM Examination
    WHERE `ANA Pattern` IS NOT NULL
      AND TRIM(`ANA Pattern`) <> ''
    GROUP BY `ANA Pattern`
), overall AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_acl_igg) AS mean_group_avg
    FROM pattern_averages
), kept AS (
    SELECT p.pattern, p.avg_acl_igg, o.mean_group_avg
    FROM pattern_averages p
    CROSS JOIN overall o
    WHERE p.avg_acl_igg > o.mean_group_avg
)
SELECT pattern,
       avg_acl_igg,
       avg_acl_igg - mean_group_avg AS above_mean,
       avg_acl_igg - AVG(avg_acl_igg) OVER () AS from_kept_patterns_mean
FROM kept;

assumptions.assumption: A pattern is unrecorded if it is NULL or contains only whitespace; AVG ignores missing aCL IgG values, and groups with no recorded aCL IgG have no average and are excluded from the group-average mean.
